desc: Riding Yoshi into a scene: Mario rides Yoshi from Petal Meadows' hei_13 back into hei_01 the first time (story 24), where Goombella's tip scene stops the party before it normalizes Mario (christine_hei_01, as an open-world or Daily seed reaches it). Before the fix Mario stayed in the saddle with no Yoshi under him and never moved again; now he is put down standing (portYoshiRiderLost), the tip plays, and he walks off with control
